basis: What the privacy report and the published local-only audits show (docs: security/privacy-report). src/__tests__/privacyLabels.test.ts keeps this file in step with the privacy ledger's categories and with the published audits.

default.summary: With the default settings (no cloud key, no sync provider, no crash-reporting key in the build) nothing leaves the device: the local-only audit shows 0 non-local requests.

dataTypes.condition: Only in a build made with a crash-reporting key (VITE_SENTRY_DSN), and only after the user turns error reports on (Settings; off by default, refused under the local-only policy). A report holds the error's class name and where in the code, never its message, note text, titles, paths or the page address (src/lib/telemetry.ts).

apple.note: Everything under optionalFeatures is sent by the user's own choice to the service the user set up (their own key or account); the developer receives none of it, except error reports, which go to whoever runs the error tracker the build names (VITE_SENTRY_DSN).

google.userCanRequestDeletion: Nothing is held by the developer; all data is on the device.

conditionalCollection.type: App info and performance: Crash logs
conditionalCollection.condition: Only in a build made with a crash-reporting key (VITE_SENTRY_DSN), and only after the user turns error reports on (off by default, refused under the local-only policy).

optionalFeatures.sends: Whatever that request carries; listed so an audit can compare
